status: PREDECLARED. Committed before the study record is written. Immutable; later revisions are new dated files.
scope: feasibility comparison of offset trim, chopping, auto-zeroing and consumer-side correction for the canonical opamp_core (DR-013 grid-legal widths). Desk study from committed evidence plus hand calculation. Canonical design, spec targets and the proposed status of DR-009 / DR-011 are unchanged. No technique is adopted; adoption needs its own decision record and ratification act.

label_rules.measured: value read from a committed record; the record, DUT version, corner/T/VDD and N are named
label_rules.calculated: derived by an equation in the study from labelled inputs; not a simulation result
label_rules.assumed: chosen by the study to make a calculation concrete; always listed with the range varied
label_rules.unknown: no responsible bound exists; the missing input and the experiment that would supply it are named

comparison_basis.vos_definition: open-loop V(inp)-V(inn) at v(out)=0.9 V crossing (offset_dc.cir); NOT the closed-loop offset a consumer sees (DR-009 open item, unresolved here)
comparison_basis.grading_target_note: DR-009 PROPOSED allocation. Used only as a yardstick. Not ratified, not a compliance claim.

uncertainty_treatment.sigma_from_N: 1 SE of a sigma estimate = sigma/sqrt(2(N-1)); 4.1% at N=300
uncertainty_treatment.variance_budget: residual sigma graded by RSS: sum of independent variances vs 0.275^2 = 0.0756 mV^2; every term listed with label; unknown terms stay unknown and are reported as the headroom they must fit in, never as zero
uncertainty_treatment.ranges_not_points: assumed inputs are swept over a stated range and the result is quoted as a range
uncertainty_treatment.tails: a finite observed tail is not a bound; coverage of a correction range is stated for a Gaussian model AND by the rule of three (3/N) for N=300

budget.hand_calculation: unlimited, reproducible from equations in the study record
budget.note: if any run is ever added to THIS increment, a finite budget must be appended here in a new committed file before execution

later_experiments_declared_not_authorize.authorization: each needs its own issue/plan commit before execution; listed here to bound the next step. Fleet only (KLT_SIM_BACKEND=batch); no hand-launched ngspice grids.

E1_systematic_vos_pvt.what: deterministic mismatch-off Vos on the canonical DR-013 netlist over 5 corners x 3 temperatures x paired supplies
E1_systematic_vos_pvt.stop_rule: stop when the request completes or after 2 retries; a failed unit is recorded, never zero

E2_trimmed_residual_drift.what: same 100 seeds (base 20261085, chunk 0) on the canonical netlist at tt, at T in {-40,125} C and VDD in {1.62,1.98} V; per-sample difference to the 27 C / 1.8 V value
E2_trimmed_residual_drift.failed_samples: counted and reported; excluded from sigma only with the count shown
E2_trimmed_residual_drift.stop_rule: if sigma of the paired difference > 0.19 mV (the variance headroom left in the trim worksheet) any single-point trim is dead and the verdict for trim becomes 'needs hot/cold re-trim'; stop after the 4 requests regardless
E2_trimmed_residual_drift.claim_level: exploratory N=100 at one corner; not N>=300 per corner

E3_switch_headroom.what: single-corner DC check of an NMOS and an LVT-NMOS switch Ron at the d1/d2 and at the gate CM levels (0.82 V, 0.9 V, 1.024 V)
E3_switch_headroom.runs: at most 6 single-corner local runs, no grid
E3_switch_headroom.stop_rule: stop on the first answer that Ron*gm1 loss exceeds 10% at the required CM

E4_pm_cap_budget.what: AC/PM of the canonical netlist with an added capacitor on d2 of 25, 50, 100 fF
E4_pm_cap_budget.stop_rule: stop after the request; result replaces the upper-bound PM-per-fF sensitivity

closure_validation_protocol_not_part_of_.mc: N>=300 per process corner (tt, ss, ff, sf, fs)
closure_validation_protocol_not_part_of_.temperature_supply: -40/27/125 C and 1.62/1.8/1.98 V to be declared before the run
closure_validation_protocol_not_part_of_.report: measured mean, sigma, 3 sigma and tails, failed samples and their count
closure_validation_protocol_not_part_of_.switched_system: transient / PSS-like noise, ripple and settling measurements for chopping or auto-zero: tool support unknown

stop_rules: No technique is required to succeed; an evidenced infeasibility conclusion is a valid outcome.
If a worksheet cannot be bounded from labelled inputs, record the missing input and the exact experiment and stop; do not invent a number.
A calculated residual sigma is never labelled measured and never converted into a closure or compliance claim.
No target, canonical file or existing record is edited.
